name: Emmett Rusk

statedReqs.notes: Four dentists and an orthodontist, pooled. All cash, and all five of them want to walk the building.

hiddenPrefs.desc: The group will accept a lower yield for a building they can drive past on the way to the office, and Carver Mill is on the way.
They have never managed a tenant and the word 'month-to-month' frightens all five of them at once.

intro: Their accountant told them to buy something. Their accountant did not tell them what, and now it is your problem.
